description: Evaluation cases for the service desk agent. expected_document is the knowledge article that should be retrieved; null means the knowledge base genuinely has no answer and the right behaviour is to admit that rather than guess. expected_escalation is what the confidence/risk gate should decide.

cases.subject: Account keeps locking every few minutes
cases.description: My account locks itself about every ten minutes. I unlock it and it happens again.

cases.subject: Locked out again after unlocking

cases.subject: Repeated lockouts on my work login
cases.description: Something keeps locking my login. I have changed my password twice and it still happens.

cases.subject: Why does my account lock on its own
